การสกัด MEV

Definition

The process by which validators or miners maximize profits by reordering, including, or censoring transactions in a block to capture additional value beyond standard block rewards or fees.

Operational example

MEV extraction can introduce front-running and sandwich attacks, which portfolio managers must monitor as part of blockchain execution risk management.
